sets.title: One Way or Round Trip?
sets.description: Choose unidirectional or multidirectional motion verbs

items.prompt: Куда ты _____? - На работу. (Where are you going? - To work. - right now, on foot)
items.promptEnglish: Where are you going right now? - To work.
items.hint: Movement in one direction right now = unidirectional present.
items.explanation: Going in one direction right now uses unidirectional: идёшь.

items.prompt: Мы каждую субботу _____ в бассейн. (We go to the pool every Saturday.)
items.promptEnglish: We go to the pool every Saturday.
items.explanation: Regular habitual trips (go and come back) use multidirectional: ходим.

items.prompt: Вчера она _____ к врачу. (Yesterday she went to the doctor. - and came back)
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday she went to the doctor (round trip, came back).
items.hint: Past round trip (went and came back) = multidirectional past.
items.explanation: Completed round trip in past uses multidirectional: ходила (went and returned).

items.prompt: Когда я _____ домой, начался дождь. (When I was walking home, it started raining.)
items.promptEnglish: When I was walking home, it started to rain.
items.hint: Movement in one direction in progress (was walking) = unidirectional past.
items.explanation: Ongoing movement in one direction (background) uses unidirectional past: шёл.

items.prompt: Они часто _____ в Петербург на поезде. (They often go to Petersburg by train.)
items.promptEnglish: They often travel to Petersburg by train.
items.explanation: Habitual round trips by transport: multidirectional ездят.

items.prompt: Смотри, самолёт _____! (Look, a plane is flying!)
items.promptEnglish: Look, a plane is flying! (in one direction, right now)
items.hint: Movement visible right now in one direction = unidirectional present.
items.explanation: Visible movement in one direction right now: unidirectional летит.

items.prompt: Он хорошо _____. (He swims well. - general ability)
items.hint: General ability (not a specific trip) = multidirectional.
items.explanation: General ability uses multidirectional: плавает (he can swim/swims well in general).

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ на работу. (I'm going to work right now, on my way.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I'm going to work right now (in one direction).
minimalPairs.explanation: Specific one-way trip happening now: unidirectional иду.

minimalPairs.context: Я _____ на работу каждый день. (I go to work every day.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I go to work every day (habitual round trips).

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ в магазин. (She went to the store and came back.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She went to the store (and came back, past round trip).
minimalPairs.explanation: Past completed round trip: multidirectional ходила (went and returned).

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ в магазин, когда встретила подругу. (She was walking to the store when she met a friend.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She was walking to the store when she met a friend (in progress, one direction).
minimalPairs.explanation: Ongoing one-direction movement (background action being interrupted): unidirectional past шла.

sets.title: Sort and Fill
sets.description: Sort motion verb pairs and fill in the correct forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Рассортируйте глаголы движения и заполните формы

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: Unidirectional (one direction/one trip) or Multidirectional (round trip/habitual/general)?

blanks: Сейчас мы _____ в аэропорт на такси. (We are driving to the airport by taxi right now.)
Дети каждый день _____ в школу. (The children go to school every day.)
Когда он _____ через парк, он увидел белку. (When he was walking through the park, he saw a squirrel.)
Она часто _____ в Москву по работе. (She often flies to Moscow for work.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: One-way now = unidirectional; habitual = multidirectional; past one-way in progress = unidirectional past
hints: By transport, one direction, right now. Which verb?
Habitual daily round trips on foot. Which verb?
One-way movement in progress in the past (background). Which verb?
Habitual trips by air. Which verb?
explanations: One-way trip by transport happening now: unidirectional едем.
Daily habitual round trips on foot: multidirectional ходят.
Ongoing one-way movement in the past: unidirectional past шёл.
Habitual trips by air: multidirectional летает.

items.prompt: Мальчик быстро _____. (The boy runs fast. - general ability)
items.explanation: General ability uses multidirectional: бегает (runs well in general).

items.prompt: Смотри, она _____ к нам! (Look, she is running towards us!)
items.promptEnglish: Look, she is running towards us right now!
items.hint: Visible movement in one direction right now = unidirectional.
items.explanation: Visible one-directional movement right now: unidirectional бежит.

items.prompt: Вчера мы _____ на выставку. (Yesterday we went to the exhibition. - and came back)
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday we went to the exhibition (round trip).
items.explanation: Completed round trip (went and returned): multidirectional past ходили.

sets.title: Fix and Build
sets.description: Fix motion verb errors and build sentences

errorCorrection.sentence: Я каждое утро иду на работу пешком.
errorCorrection.hint: Каждое утро = habitual. Habitual trips use multidirectional.
errorCorrection.explanation: Habitual daily trips use multidirectional: хожу (not unidirectional иду, which means 'right now').

errorCorrection.sentence: Смотри, птица летает прямо к нам!
errorCorrection.hint: Moving in one direction towards us right now = unidirectional.
errorCorrection.explanation: Visible one-way movement right now: unidirectional летит (not multidirectional летает).

errorCorrection.sentence: Когда он ходил домой, он потерял ключи.
errorCorrection.hint: In-progress movement in one direction (background for the interruption) = unidirectional past.
errorCorrection.explanation: Ongoing one-way movement (was walking home) uses unidirectional: шёл (not ходил, which means round trip/habitual).
General ability uses multidirectional: плавает (not unidirectional плывёт, which means swimming right now in one direction).

translation.english: Where are you going? (on foot, right now)
translation.hint: One direction, right now, on foot = unidirectional идти: идёшь
translation.grammarFocus: Unidirectional present for current one-way movement

translation.hint: Habitual trips by air = multidirectional летать: летает

translation.english: Yesterday I went to the museum. (and came back)
translation.hint: Past round trip on foot = multidirectional past: ходил
translation.grammarFocus: Multidirectional past for completed round trip

translation.english: The children were running in the park.
translation.hint: Running around (no specific direction) = multidirectional: бегали
translation.grammarFocus: Multidirectional for movement without specific direction

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All motion verb pairs in different contexts
sets.descriptionRussian: Все пары глаголов движения в разных контекстах

items.prompt: В детстве мы каждое лето _____ на море. (In childhood we went to the sea every summer.)
items.promptEnglish: In childhood we went to the sea every summer.
items.hint: Habitual past trips by transport = multidirectional past.
items.explanation: Habitual past trips (каждое лето) use multidirectional: ездили.

items.prompt: Тише! Корабль _____. (Quiet! The ship is sailing. - moving in one direction)
items.promptEnglish: Quiet! The ship is sailing (one direction, right now).
items.hint: Visible movement in one direction = unidirectional present.
items.explanation: One-direction movement right now: unidirectional плывёт.

items.prompt: Мой брат _____ в спортзал три раза в неделю. (My brother goes to the gym three times a week.)
items.promptEnglish: My brother goes to the gym three times a week.
items.explanation: Habitual trips (three times a week) use multidirectional: ходит.

minimalPairs.context: Мы _____ в Москву на поезде. (We are traveling to Moscow by train right now.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: We are traveling to Moscow right now.
minimalPairs.explanation: One-direction trip happening now: unidirectional едем.

minimalPairs.context: Мы часто _____ в Москву на поезде. (We often travel to Moscow by train.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: We often travel to Moscow by train.

minimalPairs.context: Рыба _____ в аквариуме. (The fish swims around in the aquarium.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The fish swims around in the aquarium (no specific direction).
minimalPairs.explanation: Movement without specific direction: multidirectional плавает.

minimalPairs.context: Рыба _____ к берегу. (The fish is swimming towards the shore.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The fish is swimming towards the shore (one direction).
minimalPairs.explanation: One-direction movement towards a destination: unidirectional плывёт.
